sources.title: Crouton Alpha - API Pricing & Providers | OpenRouter
sources.snippet: Crouton Alpha is a lightweight model built for scalable coding, agentic, and multimodal workflows. It's ideal for executing agentic sub-tasks, tool use, and document analysis in high-volume, repeated work. Developers can combine it with frontier reasoning models to execute the bounded steps that turn plans and information into action.

sources.title: Crouton Alpha Tested: The Free Stealth Model Built for Subagents
sources.snippet: What is Crouton Alpha? Crouton Alpha is a stealth AI model currently being tested for free on social media and developer channels. It is built for scalable coding, agentic workflows, and multimodal tasks, with a focus on subtasks, tool use, and document analysis rather than long freeform chat.
